name: Shop Manager UAT

tests.title: Site opens securely
steps: Open https://shop.ralfiz.com in Chrome on the laptop.
Click the icon left of the address.
tests.expected: The login page loads with a padlock / 'Connection is secure'. No 'Not secure' warning.

tests.title: Log in and out
steps: Log in with your own username and password.
Check the greeting on the home page.
Click your name → Log out.
Press the browser Back button.
tests.expected: Login works, the home page greets you by name. After logout, Back does not show the app; you are asked to log in again.

tests.title: Wrong password
steps: Log in with your username and a wrong password.
tests.expected: A clear error is shown and you stay on the login page.

tests.title: Change your own password
steps: Open Profile.
Change your password, log out, log in with the new one.
tests.expected: The new password works; the old one doesn't.

sections.name: Step 1 · Shop setup (Admin – do this first)

tests.title: Business details
steps: Settings → Business: fill shop name, tagline, phone, address, city, state, pincode.
Upload a logo (PNG/JPG).
Pick a brand colour. Save.
tests.expected: 'Settings saved'. Name and logo show in the app. They appear on receipts and A4 invoices (checked later in BIL-13 and BIL-14).

tests.title: GST details
steps: Settings → GST: tick GST registered, enter a test GSTIN (e.g. 32ABCDE1234F1Z5), state Kerala, decide 'prices include GST'. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. Bills show CGST + SGST for Kerala customers (checked in BIL-04).

tests.title: Financial year and bill numbers
steps: Settings → Billing: financial year starts in April (4).
Prefixes: sales invoice INV, credit note CN, purchase PUR, purchase return PR.
Default bill format: thermal receipt. Leave 'Allow negative stock' unticked. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. The first bill made later is numbered INV/26-27/0001, the first purchase PUR/26-27/0001 (the year part is this financial year, April 2026 – March 2027).

tests.title: Bank and UPI details
steps: Settings → Bank & UPI: enter bank name, account number, IFSC, branch and a UPI ID. Save.
tests.expected: Bank details print on A4 invoices. The UPI QR appears on the billing screen (BIL-07).

tests.title: Opening balances
steps: Settings → Opening balances: date = today, opening cash in drawer ₹2,000, bank balance ₹50,000. Save.
Open Accounts → Daily ledger for today.
tests.expected: The ledger starts with cash ₹2,000 and bank ₹50,000 before any sale.

tests.title: Bill text
steps: Settings → Bill text: edit terms, warranty policy, keep-the-bill note and footer. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. The text is printed on receipts and A4 invoices (checked later in BIL-13 and BIL-14).

tests.title: Categories and brands
steps: Inventory → Categories & brands: add categories Watches, Clocks, Accessories.
Add brands Titan, Fastrack, Casio, Sonata, Ajanta.
tests.expected: All appear and can be picked on a product.

tests.title: Starter products (shared by everyone)
steps: Products → Add these 10, all GST 18%, SKU and barcode left blank:
Titan Neo Analog · Watches / Titan · HSN 9102 · cost 1500 · MRP 2995 · selling 2495 · opening stock 20 · warranty 12 months, Warranty
Fastrack Reflex Band · Watches / Fastrack · HSN 9102 · cost 1200 · MRP 2495 · selling 1995 · opening stock 15 · warranty 12 months, Guarantee (replacement)
Casio Vintage A158 · Watches / Casio · HSN 9102 · cost 1600 · MRP 3195 · selling 2895 · opening stock 10 · warranty 24 months, Warranty
Sonata Kids Watch · Watches / Sonata · HSN 9102 · cost 350 · MRP 799 · selling 699 · opening stock 25 · warranty 6 months, Warranty
Titan Couple Set · Watches / Titan · HSN 9102 · cost 4500 · MRP 8995 · selling 7995 · opening stock 3 · warranty 12 months, Warranty
Ajanta Wall Clock · Clocks / Ajanta · HSN 9105 · cost 450 · MRP 999 · selling 849 · opening stock 8 · warranty 12 months, Warranty
Ajanta Alarm Clock · Clocks / Ajanta · HSN 9105 · cost 180 · MRP 399 · selling 349 · opening stock 12 · warranty none
Casio Digital Clock · Clocks / Casio · HSN 9105 · cost 600 · MRP 1295 · selling 1095 · opening stock 5 · warranty 12 months, Warranty
Leather Strap 20mm · Accessories · HSN 9113 · cost 80 · MRP 299 · selling 249 · opening stock 30 · warranty none
Watch Battery SR626 · Accessories · HSN 8506 · cost 15 · MRP 60 · selling 50 · opening stock 100 · warranty none
tests.expected: All 10 saved with their own barcode and SKU, stock as entered. Everyone else bills, returns and claims warranty on these.

tests.title: Starter customers
steps: Customers → Add: 'Test Credit Customer', phone 9000000001, Kerala, credit limit 1000.
Add 'Kerala B2B Traders', phone 9000000002, GSTIN 32AABCK1234L1Z2, Kerala.
Add 'Mumbai Time House', phone 9000000003, GSTIN 27AABCM1234L1Z6, Maharashtra.
tests.expected: All 3 listed and can be found by phone on the billing screen.

tests.title: Starter suppliers
steps: Suppliers → Add 'Kochi Watch Distributors', Kerala, GSTIN 32AABCD1234E1Z3, 30 credit days.
Add 'Mumbai Watch Co', Maharashtra, GSTIN 27AABCW1234E1Z9.
tests.expected: Both saved and listed.

tests.title: Expense and income categories
steps: Accounts → Categories: add expense categories Tea & snacks, Electricity, Rent.
Add income category Battery replacement.
tests.expected: They can be picked when adding an expense or income (FIN-01, FIN-02).

tests.title: Starter barcode labels
steps: Inventory → Barcode labels: pick all 10 starter products, 3 labels each, show price. Print.
Hand the sheet to the billing tester.
tests.expected: Labels print clearly, one product per label, with name, price and barcode.

tests.title: Tell the team setup is done
steps: Check that SET-01 … MST-06 above are all marked.
Message the group: 'Shop setup done, start your sections.'
tests.expected: Once every test in this section is marked, the other sections unlock in everyone's UAT page.

tests.title: Add your own product with automatic barcode
steps: Products → Add 'S - Test Watch' (your initial first): category Watches, brand Titan, HSN 9102, GST 18%, cost 1500, MRP 2995, selling 2495.
Leave SKU and barcode blank. Warranty 12 months, cover type Warranty. Opening stock 10. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. A 13-digit barcode and an SKU are generated. Stock shows 10. Margin is shown.

tests.title: Selling price above MRP
steps: Edit your own product from INV-02, set selling price higher than MRP, save.
tests.expected: A clear error 'Selling price is above MRP' and nothing is saved.

tests.title: Product with its own barcode
steps: Add a product. Click into the Barcode field and scan the printed barcode on a real box with the USB scanner. Save.
tests.expected: The scanned number fills the field (the form is not submitted early or doubled). Saved with that barcode.

tests.title: Stock adjustment
steps: Open your own product from INV-02 → Adjust stock: remove 1 as damaged, with a note.
Open Stock movements.
tests.expected: Stock drops by 1. The movement log shows the adjustment, the user and the note.

tests.title: Find a product by scanning
steps: Click the top search box. Scan a product's barcode.
tests.expected: The product's page opens directly.

tests.title: Low stock alert
steps: Set the reorder level of your own product from INV-02 above its stock.
Open Home and Reports → Stock.
tests.expected: The home page warns about low stock and the item is on the reorder list.

tests.title: Delete rules
steps: Add one more product of your own and delete it before selling it.
Try to delete the starter product Titan Neo Analog (it has been sold by then).
tests.expected: The unused one is deleted. The sold one is refused with a clear message (not an error page).

tests.title: Print a barcode label sheet
steps: Inventory → Barcode labels: pick 3 products, 4 labels each, show price and MRP. Create label sheet. Print on A4 (label paper if available).
tests.expected: Labels are sized as in Settings, aligned to the sheet, and the text and barcode are sharp and not cut.

tests.title: Scan printed labels
steps: Take the printed labels from LBL-01 to the billing screen and scan each with the USB scanner.
tests.expected: Every label adds the right product at the right price.

tests.title: Scan labels with a phone camera
steps: On the phone, open Billing, tap the camera button, scan a printed label.
tests.expected: The camera opens, reads the barcode and adds the product, with a beep.

tests.title: Enter a purchase bill
steps: Purchases → New purchase: Kerala supplier, bill number, date.
Add 3 items by scanning and by typing names. Enter qty, cost, GST, MRP and selling price. Pay part of it. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. Stock of each item goes up by the qty. Cost/MRP/selling price update on the products. Totals show CGST + SGST.

tests.title: Purchase from another state
steps: Enter a purchase from the other-state supplier.
tests.expected: Tax is IGST, not CGST + SGST.

tests.title: Supplier payments and statement
steps: Supplier payments → Add: pay the rest of PUR-02's bill.
Open the supplier → statement / PDF.
tests.expected: The supplier's balance becomes zero; the statement lists the bill and both payments.

tests.title: Overdue supplier bill
steps: Enter a purchase dated 40 days ago from the 30-day supplier, unpaid.
Open Home.
tests.expected: The home page warns that a supplier bill is overdue.

tests.title: Purchase return
steps: Open a purchase → Return 1 item.
tests.expected: Stock goes down by 1 and the supplier's balance goes down.

tests.title: New item while entering a purchase
steps: On New purchase, scan a barcode that isn't in the system.
tests.expected: The app offers to add it as a new product; after saving you are back on the purchase with it added.

tests.title: Supplier catalog import
steps: Purchases → Catalog import: download the template.
Fill 3 rows: one existing barcode with a new price, two new items. Upload → check preview → Apply.
tests.expected: The preview shows 1 update and 2 new. After applying, the prices and new products are in Products.

tests.title: A4 invoice style
steps: Settings → A4 invoice: style 'Classic GST form'.
Change heading, copy labels, minimum item rows to 10, declaration. Save.
Open any bill → A4 invoice PDF. Repeat with style 'Modern'.
tests.expected: The classic PDF looks like the paper GST form: boxed GSTIN, Original/Duplicate/Triplicate labels, billed-to and shipped-to boxes, totals box, bank details, signatory. Your changed text appears. Modern style also works. Each fits on one page for a short bill.

tests.title: Letterhead image
steps: Upload a wide image as Letterhead header. Save.
Open an A4 invoice PDF.
Remove the image again.
tests.expected: With the image, it replaces the logo + name header. Without it, the logo and details are back.

tests.title: Rows per page
steps: Set rows per page to 10. Open Products and Bills.
tests.expected: Lists show 10 rows with page links; next/previous work.

tests.title: Create a Staff user
steps: Users → Add: name, username, role Staff, password twice. Save.
Log in as that user in another browser (or incognito).
tests.expected: The staff user can bill, enter purchases, stock and daily entries. They do NOT see Users, Settings, Employees, Salaries, Catalog import, or Delete / Cancel buttons.

tests.title: Create a second Admin
steps: Add a user with role Admin. Log in as them.
tests.expected: They see Settings and Users.

tests.title: Deactivate a user
steps: Edit the staff user from USR-01, untick Active, save.
Try to log in as them.
tests.expected: Login is refused.

tests.title: Licence card in the sidebar
steps: Log in with the Admin login.
Look at the bottom of the left sidebar.
Log out and log in with a Staff login; look again.
tests.expected: Admin sees a licence card: Active, days left, a bar, 'Valid till' date and the Ralfiz phone number. Staff does not see the card.

tests.title: Check licence now
steps: As Admin, click the licence card in the sidebar.
On the Software licence page click 'Check now'.
tests.expected: A green message 'Licence checked: valid till …' appears, and 'Last checked with Ralfiz' shows the current time.

tests.title: Bill by scanning
steps: Billing: press F2, scan a product. Scan the same product again. Scan a second product.
tests.expected: Each scan adds the right item and price. A repeat scan raises the quantity to 2 instead of adding a new line. The total updates at once.

tests.title: Bill by name search
steps: Type part of a product name, choose it from the list.
tests.expected: The item is added.

tests.title: Camera scanning on the laptop and phone
steps: Tap the camera button, allow camera, hold a barcode in front.
tests.expected: The barcode is read and the item added. Note any device where it doesn't work.

tests.title: Discounts, GST and round off
steps: Add 2 items. Give one a line discount of 50 and a bill discount of 100.
Save, open the A4 invoice.
tests.expected: The bill discount is shared across lines. CGST and SGST are each half the GST. Round off makes a whole-rupee total. The numbers on screen, receipt and A4 invoice all match. Check one line by hand.

tests.title: Cash payment and change
steps: Total ₹449: type cash received 500.
tests.expected: 'Change to give ₹51' shows. The bill saves as paid.

tests.title: Split payment
steps: Click Split: part cash, part UPI. Save.
tests.expected: Both payments are on the bill detail page and in the daily ledger under cash and bank.

tests.title: UPI QR with amount
steps: Set the payment mode to UPI. Check the QR under Payment.
Click 'Show to customer'. Scan it with GPay / PhonePe on your phone. DON'T pay.
Change the amount (add an item) and scan again.
tests.expected: The QR appears only for UPI. The UPI app shows the shop's UPI ID and name and exactly the UPI amount, with the bill note. After the total changes the QR shows the new amount. Esc closes the full-screen view.

tests.title: Walk-in customer can't take credit
steps: Bill without choosing a customer and collect less than the total.
tests.expected: Saving is refused: walk-in bills must be fully paid.

tests.title: Credit bill and credit limit
steps: Choose 'Test Credit Customer' (credit limit 1000, from setup).
Bill ₹800 with nothing paid → save.
Bill another ₹800 unpaid.
tests.expected: The first saves as credit (unpaid). The second is refused because it would exceed the credit limit.

tests.title: Business (B2B) bill
steps: Choose 'Kerala B2B Traders' (GSTIN 32…) → bill, save, open A4 invoice.
Repeat with 'Mumbai Time House' (GSTIN 27…).
tests.expected: The invoice shows the customer GSTIN and state code. The Kerala bill has CGST + SGST; the other-state bill has IGST.

tests.title: Pause a bill, serve the next customer
steps: Add 2 items for customer A. Press F8 (Pause bill).
Bill customer B fully and save.
Click A's paused bill in the bar at the top → finish and save.
Pause another bill, then discard it.
tests.expected: B's bill isn't mixed with A's. A's items, discounts and customer come back exactly. A discarded bill disappears from the bar.

tests.title: Not enough stock
steps: Bill 4 of 'Titan Couple Set' (only 3 in stock).
tests.expected: Saving is refused with 'Only N of … in stock'.

tests.title: Thermal receipt prints correctly
steps: Save & print (F9). Print on the 80 mm printer.
tests.expected: One click prints. Logo, shop name, items, GST, total, payments, warranty lines, keep-the-bill note and barcode fit the paper width. Nothing is cut on the right. No browser header/footer text.

tests.title: A4 GST invoice prints correctly
steps: Bill detail → A4 invoice PDF → print on A4.
tests.expected: Everything is inside the page margins. The details match Settings and the bill.

tests.title: QR for a balance due
steps: Make a credit bill (BIL-09) and print its receipt and A4 invoice.
Scan the printed QR with a UPI app (don't pay).
Open the bill page on screen.
tests.expected: The receipt, A4 invoice and bill page show 'Scan to pay' with the balance due. The UPI app shows exactly the balance. A fully paid bill shows no QR.

tests.title: Scan the receipt barcode to find the bill
steps: Click the top search box. Scan the barcode printed at the bottom of a receipt.
tests.expected: That bill's page opens.

tests.title: Share and email a bill
steps: On the phone, open a bill → Send → Share PDF (WhatsApp).
Try 'Email' with your address.
tests.expected: Share opens the phone's share sheet with the PDF. Email isn't set up yet on this server, so a clear message says so (not an error page). Note what you see.

tests.title: Cancel a bill
steps: As Staff, look for a Cancel button on a bill.
As Admin, cancel a bill.
tests.expected: Staff have no Cancel. After Admin cancels, the bill shows CANCELLED and its stock comes back.

tests.title: Billing on a phone
steps: Make a full bill on the phone browser: add items, customer, payment, save.
tests.expected: Everything is usable without zooming or sideways scrolling; buttons are easy to tap.

tests.title: Return with cash refund
steps: Open a paid bill → Return 1 of 2 items, refund cash.
tests.expected: A credit note is created (CN/…). Stock comes back. The refund shows in the daily ledger as cash out.

tests.title: Exchange / adjust to account
steps: Return an item from a customer's bill and choose exchange or adjust to their account.
tests.expected: The customer's balance changes by the return amount. The credit note shows how it was settled.

tests.title: Credit note PDF
steps: Open the credit note → Print credit note.
tests.expected: The PDF shows the original bill number, items, GST reversed and amount.

tests.title: Bill with a return can't be cancelled
steps: As Admin, try to cancel the bill from RET-01.
tests.expected: Refused with a clear message.

tests.title: Add and find customers
steps: Customers → Add your own: name starting with your initial, phone, GSTIN, state, credit limit.
On Billing, type part of the phone number in the customer box.
tests.expected: The customer is found and picked; their GSTIN fills in.

tests.title: Customer history and what they owe
steps: Open the customer from BIL-09.
tests.expected: Their bills, returns, payments and outstanding balance are listed and add up.

tests.title: Collect a payment
steps: Payments received → Add: the BIL-09 customer, ₹800 by UPI, against that bill.
tests.expected: The bill becomes Paid, the customer owes ₹0, and the UPI amount is in the bank column of the daily ledger.

tests.title: Guarantee printed on the bill
steps: Sell the starter product 'Fastrack Reflex Band' (12 months guarantee) to a customer with a phone number.
Print the receipt.
tests.expected: The receipt and A4 invoice say 'Guarantee 1 year' with the valid-till date.

tests.title: Check cover
steps: Warranty → Check warranty: search by the customer's phone, then by the bill number, then by the item name.
tests.expected: The item is found each time with 'Covered · N days left', the bill number and the valid-till date. Items sold without warranty are not listed.

tests.title: Register a claim and print the slip
steps: Click Register claim on the item. Check the pre-filled fields.
Enter the serial number, complaint, condition, promised date. Save.
Print slip on the 80 mm printer.
tests.expected: Item, customer, bill date, cover type and valid-till are pre-filled. The claim gets a number like WC/26-27/0001. The slip prints cleanly with the claim number, complaint and 'Ready by' date.

tests.title: Track the repair
steps: On the claim: status 'Sent to service centre', sent to Titan Service, docket 12345, note 'couriered'. Save.
Then 'Ready for customer'. Then 'Returned to customer' with result 'Replaced with new' and the new serial in Edit.
tests.expected: Each step saves. Sent, back and returned dates fill in with today's date. Notes show the date and your name. The timeline reads correctly.

tests.title: Overdue claims
steps: Make a claim with a promised date yesterday. Leave it open.
Open Warranty and Claims & repairs → Overdue.
tests.expected: The 'Past promised date' tile counts it and it is listed under Overdue with the date in red.

tests.title: Claim without a bill / paid repair
steps: Check warranty → 'Claim without a bill': an item bought elsewhere, untick 'Within warranty', charge ₹300.
tests.expected: Saved. The slip says 'Not covered - chargeable'.

tests.title: Find claims
steps: Claims & repairs → search by serial number, docket number and phone. Try each status tab.
tests.expected: The right claim is found each time; the tabs filter correctly.

tests.title: Expenses
steps: Accounts → Expenses → Add: tea ₹120 cash, electricity ₹2400 bank, with categories.
tests.expected: Both listed. In the daily ledger the tea is under cash, the electricity under bank.

tests.title: Other income
steps: Add other income: battery replacement ₹250 cash.
tests.expected: Shown in the ledger and in the P&L.

tests.title: Cash to bank transfer
steps: Cash ⇄ Bank: move ₹5000 cash to bank.
tests.expected: Cash in drawer goes down 5000 and bank goes up 5000. Sales totals don't change.

tests.title: Employees and salary
steps: Add an employee. Pay an advance of ₹1000, then a salary.
Open the salary slip PDF.
Log in as Staff and look for Employees.
tests.expected: Payments are listed and the slip is correct. Staff can't see employees or salaries.

tests.title: Cash book
steps: Open the cash book for this week, download / print the PDF.
tests.expected: Every cash entry is there in date order with a running balance.

tests.title: Daily ledger and day close
steps: Do this last, after everyone has finished today's tests. Open the daily ledger for today and check the cash in drawer.
Day close: enter a counted amount ₹10 less than the computed balance.
tests.expected: Opening cash ₹2,000 (from SET-09) + cash sales − refunds − cash expenses − transfers = the drawer figure. Day close shows a variance of −₹10.

tests.title: Phone layout
steps: Open each menu section on the phone.
tests.expected: Every page fits the screen: no sideways scrolling, nothing overlapping, tables readable.

tests.title: Install as an app
steps: Chrome menu → 'Add to Home screen' / 'Install app'. Open it from the icon.
tests.expected: It opens full-screen like an app and you stay logged in.

tests.title: Global search
steps: Use the top search for a product name, customer phone, bill number and supplier.
tests.expected: Each is found.

tests.title: Two counters at once
steps: Two interns bill the same product at the same time on two devices and save within a few seconds of each other.
tests.expected: Both bills save with consecutive numbers and the stock goes down by both quantities.

tests.title: Speed on mobile data
steps: Turn off Wi-Fi on the phone and make a bill on mobile data.
tests.expected: Pages load in a few seconds; nothing times out. Note anything slow.

sections.name: Reports & GST (do on the last day)

tests.title: Sales report matches the bills
steps: Reports → Sales for today. Add up today's bills from the Bills list.
tests.expected: The report total equals the bills total, less cancelled bills and returns.

tests.title: Margin report
steps: Reports → Margin by item, category, brand and supplier.
tests.expected: Margin = selling value − cost for each line. Spot-check one item by hand.

tests.title: Stock value and reorder list
steps: Reports → Stock.
tests.expected: Quantities match the product pages. Stock value = qty × cost. Low items are on the reorder list.

tests.title: Monthly GST report
steps: Reports → GST for this month. Download the PDF and the Excel.
tests.expected: B2B lists the GSTIN bills from BIL-10. B2C is grouped by rate. The HSN summary, credit notes and purchase ITC are there. The PDF and Excel totals match the screen.

tests.title: Profit & loss
steps: Reports → P&L for this month.
tests.expected: Sales, cost, gross margin, expenses and other income line up with the other reports.

tests.title: Receivables and payables
steps: Reports → Outstanding.
tests.expected: Customers who owe (BIL-09 before payment) and suppliers you owe (PUR-05) are listed with the right amounts.

sections.name: Full shop day (do together at the end)

tests.title: One complete day
steps: Intern 1: enter a purchase of 5 new products and print their labels.
Intern 2: sell 6 bills using the scanner: cash, UPI with QR, split, one credit customer, one B2B. Print every receipt.
Intern 2: one return, one paused bill finished later.
Intern 3: one warranty claim from today's bill, one expense, one cash-to-bank transfer, then day close.
Together: open the dashboard, daily ledger, sales report and GST report.
tests.expected: Every figure agrees across the dashboard, ledger, reports and printed bills. Stock of the 5 products = purchased − sold + returned. Nothing needed a workaround.

instructions:
Order
1. Getting started: everyone, just the logins.
2. Shop setup: Sana, on the uat_admin login. Everything else stays locked until it's done.
3. Then everyone tests their own sections at the same time.
4. Last day: reports, day close and the full shop day together.

Rules for testing together
• Bill, return and claim only on the 10 starter products. Don't edit or delete them.
• Start anything new you create with your initial: S - , F - , M - .
• Change Settings only in your own Settings tests, and put them back.
• No day close until FIN-05 on the last day.

How to mark
• Pass: it did what 'Should happen' says.
• Fail: it did something wrong. Write what you did and saw, add a screenshot.
• Blocked: you couldn't test it (error page, missing data, no printer).
• Use Chrome on the shop laptop; your phone for camera scanning and UPI.
